findings.problem: Core federal gross-to-net rules ship as 'Not configured in this release' although the official source is already on disk and registered at tier A.2. RQ-567: the 3401(a) wage definition, so Module 6.1.1 'Taxable Income Definition' is empty. RQ-568: withholding when no Form W-4 is furnished. RQ-570: fringe exclusion conditions. RQ-572: fringe valuation rule. gaps.json shows all six as 'open' with url_searched=false, and searched[] lists internal files only. None of them is one of the orchestrator's 24 access/publication limitations or a next-year value, and the journal rule for r3 keeps items closable from what is on disk blocking. Round-2 finding 1 was cleared by rewording the marker (C29 passes mechanically), not by closing the rule: a developer still cannot build federal gross-to-net from Module 3 / 6.1.1.
findings.expected: Facts extracted from the local copies and rendered. For RQ-559/562: Pub. 15 (2026) sec. 15 'Special Rules for Various Types of Services and Payments' (US-FEDS5-029, local FED_IRS-p15-2026_2026-11-02.pdf), row 'Retirement and pension plans 2. Elective employee contributions ... 401(k)': income tax 'Generally exempt, but see section 402(g)', social security/Medicare 'Taxable', FUTA 'Taxable'. findings.evidence: QA read of the local PDFs with pdftotext: p15-2026 lines 1820-1830 (W-4 default) and 3498-3512 (401(k) row); p15b-2026 contents 'General Valuation Rule ... 26'. gaps.json RQ-559/562/567/568/570/572: status open, url_searched false.

numeric_verification.method: F44 was run against local copies only (orchestrator instruction; no WebFetch). Every [[FACT:]] tag in the DOCX (3,874 keys) was resolved to its facts entries. A key counts as numeric when any of its entry values parses as a number (2,015 keys). Each numeric entry was searched in the text of its register row's local_file, accepting v, v*100 and v/100. PDFs and files with PDF content were read with PyMuPDF; docx paragraphs and tables, xlsx and stripped html were read directly, and gzip was handled. A whole number below 100 counted as found only when a key word or synonym occurred within 250 characters. If a value was not found, QA searched every local file of the same jurisdiction (a hit counts as verified but is flagged as a possible mis-cite) and then looked for a recorded derivation in the facts or register verification_method. Result: 1,927 numeric keys verified (141 found only in another row's file, 32 through a recorded derivation). 88 numeric keys are unverified: 66 sit on 50 rows with no local_file, and 22 were not located. The 1,859 base-rule (text or boolean) keys were not re-verified mechanically and are listed as unverified.
